_note: Phase 4.9 source of truth for RUNTIME model availability. Each entry marks a catalogued model id as currently UNAVAILABLE (provider access pulled/restricted). On merge to main, sync-availability.yml reconciles this list into the Supabase model_availability table; the web /api/recommend route reads that table and forwards the ids to the selector as a runtime Step-0a override (roadmodel >=0.2.9), so a benched model is excluded WITHOUT a package release. Maintained by the daily availability probe (auto-PR). Removing an id here re-enables the model on the next sync. The bundled <availability-context> in model-selector.txt stays as a static belt-and-suspenders default.
